services.name: Tandem Flight
services.desc: Take an instructional tandem flight with one of our professional pilots and witness the beauty of the Rockies from above. Soaring above the foothills of Boulder, you’ll have the opportunity to learn how paragliding can unlock surreal views of the Continental Divide to the west, the Great Plains out to the east and Boulder’s famous Flatirons just to the south. Fitness Requirements: Passengers should have good balance and be able to run down a slope without issue. Time Commitment: Please allow 90 minutes from our scheduled meeting time until your feet are safely back on the ground. blurb: Red Tail Paragliding offers paragliding lessons including a P2 Certification Course and introductory tandem flights. They sell various models of rescue parachutes designed for paragliding safety, emphasizing fast opening times, low sink rates, and lightweight designs. Lessons run seasonally from April 1 to October 15 with flexible scheduling and a minimum of two lessons per week recommended for safe progression.
